stem: A sensor reading is outside the range listed in an SOP, but the procedure contains no instruction for exceptions or escalation. What is the main problem?
choices: The technician should automatically change every environmental setting
The SOP is incomplete because the worker cannot determine the authorized response to the out-of-range condition
The reading should be deleted from the record
The technician should ignore the range until a manager notices
rationale: A controlled procedure should define what happens when the normal process cannot be followed or acceptance criteria are not met. Unwritten exception handling creates inconsistent work.
